# Numerical stability study (generated by scripts/stability_study.py)

Single absorbing layer between air and fused silica, 45 deg, s-polarisation.
Engines: **tmmax** (T-matrix, complex64), **T-matrix c128** (same algorithm, complex128, no cap), **Byrnes tmm** (T-matrix float64, caps $\mathrm{Im}(\delta)$ at 35), **stable** (S-matrix, complex128).

## Ge (tmmax DB) @ 532 nm  ($q$ = 3.417+2.614j, $\mathrm{Im}(\delta)$ per nm = 0.0309)
- tmmax R/T first wrong or non-finite at d = 2900 nm ($\sum\mathrm{Im}(\delta)$ = 89.5); value R = nan
- tmmax gradient $\partial R/\partial d$ first wrong at d = 1500 nm ($\sum\mathrm{Im}(\delta)$ = 46.3); $\partial R/\partial d$ = 0.0367 /nm vs 2.73e-42 /nm
- complex128 T-matrix (no cap) first fails at d = 24770 nm ($\sum\mathrm{Im}(\delta)$ = 764.6)
- stable S-matrix: all values finite = True; max $|R-R_{\mathrm{Byrnes}}|$ = 5.6e-16

## tmmax compatibility checks
- x64 enabled: FAILS: TypeError: scan body function carry input and carry output must have equal types, but they differ:
- grad(tmm()) eager: works
- jit(grad(tmm())): FAILS: TracerBoolConversionError (np.any input validation on traced values)
- bare interface (0 layers): FAILS: IndexError
- output dtype: float32
